text:
nina_csm: FYI 1 Acorn Health renewal. Procurement sent PO and requests: Net60, split invoicing US/EU, vendor_code ACORN-OPS-77 (not in CRM), add 30 seats, keep current price, 12mo term. They want PO attached to DocuSign. Any immediate blockers?

omar_ae: On call now. Procurement prefers Net60. I'll ask if they can consolidate to single payor. They mentioned possible 4% discount for full prepay 6mo.

sylvia_fin: Net60 ok with conditions: need tax IDs, billing legal names, and confirmation of the payor. Split invoices mean more overhead; require Finance approval. Prepay discount fine but need currency to model.

ethan_legal: Amendment preferred for seats + term. DocuSign ok; wet-sign adds 3-5 biz days. Confirm VAT impact for EU split. Also check vendor_code maps to billing entity.

trina_enable: If seats added, we can provide a kickoff + 6 enablement hrs. Hold a slot tentatively week after effective date.

nina_csm: Procurement email excerpt: "VendorCode: ACORN-OPS-77; PO# 778899; prefer Net60; invoice 65% Acorn US (ap@acorn.us) 35% Acorn EU (ap-eu@acorn.eu); will sign via DocuSign; may request prepay option."

sylvia_fin: ACORN-OPS-77 not in vendor registry. Omar  please collect US EIN and EU VAT, and confirm which entity accepts liability. If split payor, Finance needs separate invoicing details.

omar_ae: I'll get TAX IDs and push for single payor. Will confirm PO attachment and whether prepay will be executed.

docusign_bot: Draft amendment created (internal): https://docusign.example/envelope/acorn-222 1 fields include PO attachment, billing allocation, signer roles.

ethan_legal: Reviewing draft. If procurement requires clause changes for EU entity, escalate to Legal.

nina_csm: Marking "vendor_code mismatch" as high risk and "Net60 with split invoices" as medium. Target: send DocuSign within 48h if docs present; +3-5 biz days if wet-sign or credit checks needed. Will update tracker.
